texts.error.core_data_missing: The core's copy of Sonic 3 A.I.R.'s data is missing: the package is damaged.
texts.error.engine_did_not_open_its_sound: The engine did not open its sound device.
texts.error.game_did_not_start: The game did not start: its scripts could not be loaded.
texts.error.mod_has_no_mod_json: %1 holds no mod: no folder in it has a mod.json.
texts.error.mod_not_a_zip: %1 is not a zip. Mods are given as a zip of mod folders, each with its mod.json.
texts.error.rom_missing: The Sonic 3 & Knuckles ROM (Sonic_Knuckles_wSonic3.bin) is not there.
texts.error.rom_not_s3k: This ROM is not the one Sonic 3 A.I.R. accepts. It needs Sonic & Knuckles with Sonic 3 as one ROM, as Steam's Sega Classics has it (Sonic_Knuckles_wSonic3.bin).
texts.error.rom_wrong_size: The ROM is %1 bytes long. Sonic 3 A.I.R. needs Sonic & Knuckles with Sonic 3 as one ROM of 4194304 bytes.
texts.error.savedata_not_a_zip: The save data %1 is not a zip as Export Save Data writes it.
texts.error.savedata_not_one_this: The save data holds %1, which is not save data of this core. Mods and the ROM are files of the project.
texts.error.soundtrack_not_one: %1 is not part of the remastered soundtrack. The slot takes audioremaster.bin, or the Ogg files and audio_replacements.json of a data/audio/remastered folder.
texts.error.soundtrack_unreadable: The soundtrack file %1 could not be read.
texts.firmware.rom.about: Sonic & Knuckles with Sonic 3 locked on, as one 4 MiB ROM, as Steam's Sega Classics has it. Sonic 3 A.I.R. reads the game's levels, graphics and music from it and accepts only this ROM: the core checks it as the game does. You have to supply it. This package includes none of the game.
texts.prop.game_mode: The original game's mode (its byte at 0xFFF600)
texts.prop.ground_speed: Speed along the ground, in 1/256 of a pixel a frame
texts.prop.igt_ms: The game's timer (minutes, seconds and frames), in milliseconds
texts.prop.score: The score divided by ten (the game shows ten times this)
texts.prop.sim_frame: Frames the game has run (none while a menu is open)
texts.prop.timer_frames: The game's timer: frames within the second
texts.prop.x: Horizontal position in the level, in pixels
texts.prop.x_speed: Horizontal speed, in 1/256 of a pixel a frame
texts.prop.x_sub: Horizontal position: the fraction of a pixel, in 1/65536
texts.prop.y: Vertical position in the level, in pixels
texts.prop.y_speed: Vertical speed, in 1/256 of a pixel a frame
texts.prop.y_sub: Vertical position: the fraction of a pixel, in 1/65536
texts.slot.mods.help: Sonic 3 A.I.R. mods, as zips. Each zip holds one or more mod folders, each with its mod.json. They are loaded when the game starts, in this order, as if they were turned on in the game's Mods menu in this order. They change the game, so they are part of the machine: a movie needs the same zips.
texts.slot.savedata.help: The game's save data to start with, as Export Save Data wrote it: a zip of its options, its save slots and its unlocks. The game reads it, so a movie needs the same file.
texts.slot.soundtrack.help: The remastered soundtrack from your own Sonic 3 A.I.R. installation: its audioremaster.bin, or the Ogg files and audio_replacements.json of a data/audio/remastered folder. Without it, the game plays the original music from the ROM, whatever its Soundtrack option says. It changes the sound only.
